title: Orbs summoned to hover over Jay Anderson's house

tellings.quote: a meditative state and made requests for something to turn up and float down and hover above my house

plain: A man named Jay Anderson says that in recent years he went into a meditative state and asked for something to appear and float down over his house. He says glowing orbs then came and hovered above it, which he tells on Jesse Michels's podcast as a sign that the phenomenon answers requests.
